checks.description: Check nonempty output, minimal HTML shell and explicit stylesheet/module references, JSON and JavaScript syntax, and common literal local resource paths. Does not prove rendered content, event wiring, accessibility or visual quality.

Inspect 360px/1440px hierarchy and mainstream business credibility. Try menu/anchors, invalid and corrected enquiry, Other area, edit/re-preview and safe summary text. Confirm no submission, keyboard focus and complete supplied facts.
